pattern.top_pattern: VA post-acute spending is shifting into SNF and NF care
pattern.what_is_impacting: VA / SNF - FREE STANDING and NF / DSNP HMO, Medicare HMO
key_driver_codes: Bone Diseases and Arthropathies with MCC
pattern.pattern_details: VA post-acute growth is showing up primarily in SNF and NF settings rather than only in acute hospitals. The largest piece is DSNP HMO SNF volume without authorization, with additional contribution from musculoskeletal and osteomyelitis-related NF cases and pockets of higher paid per admit. This points to a post-acute site-of-care management opportunity.
pattern.why_it_matters: Rapid SNF and NF growth can erode savings if placement, length of stay, and preferred-facility steering are not tightly managed.
pattern.recommended_next_step: Tighten post-acute placement criteria and preferred SNF steering in VA, and run concurrent review on musculoskeletal and osteomyelitis-related SNF/NF stays.
evidence_summary: VA DSNP HMO SNF without authorization added +$50.9M on 5,828 more admissions.
Additional VA SNF mixed pressure added +$1.1M, led by Bone Diseases and Arthropathies with MCC.
VA NF musculoskeletal cases added +$771K, led by bilateral primary knee osteoarthritis at +$346K.
Rare VA NF osteomyelitis cases added +$294K on low volumes.
